excludedOutputs: calibrated goodness-of-fit p-values or accept-reject decisions after parameter estimation
confidence intervals for fitted parameters or information-criterion differences
shifted-location, censored, truncated, mixture, discrete, heavy-tail, or custom probability families

methods.implementedBoundary: Two equal-length finite vectors: Pearson correlation, r-squared, t reference test, and Fisher-transformed confidence interval.

methods.implementedBoundary: Two equal-length finite vectors: average-rank Spearman correlation, exact permutation p values when n is at most nine without ties, otherwise a declared t approximation, plus a transformed interval.

methods.implementedBoundary: Two equal-length finite vectors: Kendall tau-b with tie-aware pair counts, exact permutation p values when n is at most nine without ties, otherwise a tie-corrected normal approximation.

knownGaps: No partial, weighted, clustered, censored, or permutation-interval Kendall analysis.

methods.implementedBoundary: Two independent finite groups: Welch-Satterthwaite t test, mean-difference interval, standardized mean differences, and directional alternatives.
